target.statement: Mean Sentinel-2 dNBR for vineyard pixels inside the Kincade Fire perimeter = 0.130 (vs 0.337 for wildland pixels)
target.dataset: Sentinel-2 SR Harmonized composites over the 2019 Kincade Fire perimeter, intersected with CA DWR 2019 vineyard polygons

compute.basis: All inputs are public (Sentinel-2, WFIGS perimeter, DWR crop polygons, Zenodo analysis-ready products), but the Sentinel-2 median composites are built in Google Earth Engine (71 pre-fire + 24 post-fire scenes) and the pipeline is a multi-stage orchestrator; on a laptop this means either GEE exports or downloading/processing ~95 scenes locally, plus polygon zonal statistics.

blockers: Core compositing is implemented in Google Earth Engine, requiring a GEE account and export workflow rather than a pure local run
Repository completeness/configs not verifiable from the paper text; may need to rebuild parts of the pipeline
Large Sentinel-2 scene downloads and mosaicking are I/O heavy on a laptop
title: Multisource Remote Sensing and Geospatial Analysis of Vineyard Wildfire Impacts and Resilience: The 2019 Kincade Fire
